title: Horticultural Sales Advisor
description:
Horticultural Sales Advisor Hertfordshire DOE + Benefits

The Role

We're looking for a Horticultural Sales Advisor with strong horticultural and tree knowledge to join an established and award-winning nursery in Hertfordshire.

You'll work closely with customers visiting the nursery, as well as handling enquiries by phone and email. You'll advise on tree and plant selection, planting schemes and the practicalities of supply, delivery and planting, while preparing quotes and ensuring excellent follow-through from enquiry to completion.

This role is for someone who combines horticultural expertise with commercial awareness, enjoys building customer relationships and is confident developing new business.

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- Passionate about horticulture with strong tree knowledge
- Commercially aware, with experience of sales and/or business development
- Confident communicating with customers face-to-face, by phone and email
- Organised, proactive and able to work independently and as part of a team
- Comfortable working under pressure with excellent attention to detail
- IT literate with strong administration skills
- Committed to providing excellent customer service
- Garden design experience and the ability to read plans would be a strong advantage.

What's on offer?
- Competitive salary + pooled commission
- 25% profit sharing, paid twice yearly
- 28 days' holiday, with additional days available for long service
- Company pension and life assurance
- Group Income Protection
- 50% employee discount
- BUPA and dental cover for long-service employees
- Employee-Owned Trust

title: Internal Sales Development Representative
company: Room at the Top Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are thrilled to offer a new and exciting opportunity for an Internal Sales Development Representative to join our well-established and successful client located in Hertfordshire. As our client continues to grow, they are investing in their sales function to expand and strengthen existing relationships and identify new business opportunities.

This is a newly created position offering an exciting opportunity to make a direct contribution to the growth of our business. As an Internal Sales Development Representative, you will focus on identifying prospective corporate customers, generating new business opportunities and re-engaging businesses that have previously used our services. Through proactive outbound calling, targeted prospect research and relationship building, you will introduce our services to potential customers and develop a strong pipeline of opportunities for our sales team and local branch managers. This is a great opportunity to grow with the business as the sales function develops.

This is a permanent role offering a hybrid working arrangement of 4 days from home and 1 day in the office. The hours are 8am-5pm, Monday-Friday. The role offers a competitive salary of £28,000-£32,000 depending on experience plus commission, performance related bonus and incentives.

Key Responsibilities
- High-Volume Prospecting: Maintain strong daily outbound phone activity to generate new corporate leads and introduce our services to local businesses.
- Lead Generation & Data Sourcing: Identify and map out prospective local businesses within our operational delivery radius.
- Qualification & Discovery: Uncover fleet requirements, short-term rental needs, and vehicle pain points through concise phone discovery.
- Meeting Booking: Secure qualified phone, virtual, or in-person meetings for our Business Development team and Local Branch Managers.
- Account Opening: Guide interested businesses through opening local corporate credit/trade accounts with us.
- Processing Dormant Leads: Contacting clients with dormant or inactive accounts to win back their business/account.
- CRM & Activity Management: Accurately track all daily dials, call notes, pipeline updates, and upcoming follow-ups in our CRM.

Key Requirements and Experience
- Experience: Previous experience in outbound sales, telemarketing, lead generation, or account development (B2 B experience in vehicle rental, fleet management, logistics, or local service sales is an advantage, but not essential).
- Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a confident, persuasive phone manner.
- Proactive Mindset: Self-motivated, resilient, and driven by achieving and exceeding target activity levels.
- Relationship Building: Ability to connect quickly with business managers, fleet directors, and procurement leads.
- Commercial Awareness: Ability to understand customer needs quickly and articulate how corporate vehicle credit accounts add value to their business.
- Local Knowledge: Basic local knowledge of our surrounding areas is required. This is to ensure they connect with local businesses on common ground.
- We use Google Workspace for communications and training given on use of our in-house bespoke CRM.

Additional benefits include:
- 20 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing to 22 days after two years and 23 days after five years.
- Company laptop & phone
- Workplace pension, subject to scheme terms and eligibility requirements.
- Employee Recognition Award.
- Employee Referral Scheme.
- Bike 2 Work Scheme.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. If you do not hear from us, please assume your application has not been successful on this occasion. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best of luck in your job search.

title: Customer Service Executive
description:
Customer Service Executive

Location: Stevenage
Salary: £26,000 - £28,000 per annum
Job Type: Full Time, Permanent

Customer Service Executive About the Company

Our client is a successful and growing business based in Stevenage, supplying products and solutions to customers across the UK and internationally.

They are looking for a proactive and customer-focused Customer Service Executive to join their established team. This is a varied role covering customer service, account management, administration and commercial support, with responsibility for managing a portfolio of B2 B customers.

You'll be a key point of contact for customers, ensuring orders are handled smoothly, queries are resolved promptly and opportunities to support account growth are identified.

Customer Service Executive Details
- Monday to Friday, full-time
- Based in Stevenage
- £26,000 - £28,000 per annum
- Bonus Scheme
- 23 days' annual leave plus Bank Holidays
- Additional employee benefits and wellbeing support
- Company pension scheme
- Free onsite parking
- Long-term development opportunities

Customer Service Executive Responsibilities
- Manage a portfolio of B2 B customer accounts and act as their main point of contact
- Build and maintain strong customer relationships
- Handle customer enquiries, requests and complaints promptly and professionally
- Proactively contact customers to understand their needs and maintain engagement
- Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling and account growth
- Re-engage inactive or declining accounts
- Promote new products, offers and campaigns
- Recommend suitable products based on customer requirements
- Maintain accurate customer and order records
- Work with internal teams to resolve issues and maintain service levels
- Share customer feedback and commercial opportunities with the wider business

Customer Service Executive What We're Looking For
- Previous experience in customer service, account management or a similar customer-facing role
- Confident communication skills and an ability to build relationships
- Customer-focused with good commercial awareness
- Proactive approach with confidence to pick up the phone
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Ability to manage multiple accounts and competing priorities
- Positive, professional and self-motivated approach

If you're a customer-focused professional looking for a varied role where you can build relationships, manage customer accounts and contribute to business growth, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today with your CV.

title: German/Hebrew Customer Service
description:
Our client based in Watford is seeking a German and Hebrew speaking Customer service Advisor, both languages need to be written and spoken.
Hybrid working

In this role you will build and maintain strong client relationships by serving as the lead point of contact for dedicated customers. The Account Coordinator will manage activities through to completion and communicate back to the client. Act as liaison between the company client and our clients teams and will collaborate with key internal stakeholders to drive our clients initiative. They will be responsible to ensure account long-term profitability by understanding and ensuring current contractual terms and conditions are in place.
You will be responsible for both the retention and growth of their existing client base, as well as soliciting client feedback and driving customer satisfaction.
Key Responsibilities:
- Serve as lead point of contact for clients, answering questions, addressing concerns, finding solutions, communicating updates, and handling transactional sales opportunities.
- Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with clients, and proactively address client retention and growth.
- Monitor service, equipment, and consumable contracts to ensure execution of Terms & Conditions, including profitability approved by the business.
- Evaluate the customer's current service plan and provide recommendations based on the client's needs and suite of products.
- Monitor clients recurring revenue trends while driving efficiencies through the entire ordering process and educating and driving use usage of Partner Place.
- Coordinate each department to deliver and exceed the requirement of the customer.
- Partner and understand internal departments, processes, and stakeholders. This includes, but not limited to, Service, Invoicing, Implementation, Contracts, Incident Handling, Engineering, and Credit and Collections.
- Align with Sales team on customer expectations, growth, and retention strategies. An emphasis on driving a positive experience with both new and current equipment and assisting Sales.
- Collaborate with Sales team to identify upsell opportunities, and referrals while keeping customers satisfied and engaged with the current product portfolio.
- Assess client needs and find creative solutions to assist and manage challenging customers requests and escalation.
